children: Inhibikase updated its corporate presentation to highlight progress on the Phase 3 IKT-001 program and anticipated clinical timelines.
Furnished updated corporate presentation (Exhibit 99.1) describing IKT-001 development for pulmonary arterial hypertension.
Phase 3 IMPROVE-PAH enrolling across 26 countries, 46 active sites of ~180 planned; program includes Part A (PVR) and Part B (6MWD).
Company positions IKT-001 as a once-daily prodrug of imatinib with reduced GI exposure and improved tolerability to enable higher dosing.
Timelines: interim safety readout 1H 2027, Part A PVR readout mid-2028, Part B 6MWD topline mid-2029; cash runway to Phase 3 topline data.
Notes orphan drug designation, 505(b)(2) pathway, IP runway to 2044 and reliance on prior imatinib data to inform design and probability of success.
